title: Tidy and prepare a pedigree using graph theory — tidyped
text: ped data.table data frame containing pedigree. first three columns must individual, sire, dam IDs. Additional columns, sex generation, can included. Column names can customized, order must remain unchanged. Individual IDs coded "", " ", "0", "*", "NA"; otherwise, removed. Missing parents denoted "NA", "0", "*". Spaces empty strings ("") also treated missing parents recommended. cand character vector individual IDs, NULL. provided, candidates ancestors/descendants retained. trace character value specifying tracing direction: "", "", "". "" traces ancestors; "" traces descendants; "" traces union ancestors descendants. parameter used cand NULL. Default "". tracegen integer specifying number generations trace. parameter used trace NULL. NULL 0, available generations traced. addgen logical value indicating whether generate generation numbers. Default TRUE, adds Gen column output. addnum logical value indicating whether generate numeric pedigree. Default TRUE, adds IndNum, SireNum, DamNum columns output. inbreed logical value indicating whether calculate inbreeding coefficients. Default FALSE. TRUE, f column added output. ... Additional arguments passed inbreed.

title: Tidy and prepare a pedigree using graph theory — tidyped
text: tidyped object (inherits data.table). Individual, sire, dam ID columns renamed Ind, Sire, Dam. Missing parents replaced NA. Sex column contains "male", "female", NA. Cand column included cand NULL. Gen column included addgen TRUE. IndNum, SireNum, DamNum columns included addnum TRUE. f column included inbreed TRUE.

title: Tidy and prepare a pedigree using graph theory — tidyped
text: Compared legacy version, function handles cyclic pedigrees robustly detecting reporting loops, generally faster large pedigrees due use sparse graph algorithms igraph package. Generation assignment performed using topological sorting-based algorithm ensures parents always placed generation strictly offspring (TGI algorithm).

code: library(visPedigree) library(data.table)  # Tidy a simple pedigree tidy_ped <- tidyped(simple_ped) head(tidy_ped) #> Tidy Pedigree Object #>       Ind   Sire    Dam    Sex   Gen IndNum SireNum DamNum #>    <char> <char> <char> <char> <int>  <int>   <int>  <int> #> 1: J0C032   <NA>   <NA> female     1      1       0      0 #> 2: J0C185   <NA>   <NA> female     1      2       0      0 #> 3: J0C231   <NA>   <NA> female     1      3       0      0 #> 4: J0C317   <NA>   <NA>   male     1      4       0      0 #> 5: J0C450   <NA>   <NA> female     1      5       0      0 #> 6: J0C561   <NA>   <NA>   male     1      6       0      0  # Trace ancestors of a specific individual within 2 generations tidy_ped_tracegen <- tidyped(simple_ped, cand = "J5X804", trace = "up", tracegen = 2) head(tidy_ped_tracegen) #> Tidy Pedigree Object #>       Ind   Sire    Dam    Sex   Gen IndNum SireNum DamNum   Cand #>    <char> <char> <char> <char> <int>  <int>   <int>  <int> <lgcl> #> 1: J3L886   <NA>   <NA>   male     1      1       0      0  FALSE #> 2: J3X697   <NA>   <NA> female     1      2       0      0  FALSE #> 3: J3Y620   <NA>   <NA>   male     1      3       0      0  FALSE #> 4: J3Y771   <NA>   <NA> female     1      4       0      0  FALSE #> 5: J4E185 J3L886 J3X697 female     2      5       1      2  FALSE #> 6: J4Y326 J3Y620 J3Y771   male     2      6       3      4  FALSE  # Based reported cex previous run, parameter increased labels wider shapes PDF; conversely, decreased labels narrower shapes. default value NULL. showgraph logical value indicating whether plot shown default graphic device (e.g., Plots panel RStudio). useful quick viewing without opening PDF file. TRUE, ancestors descendants individuals specified highlight highlighted. character string, specifies tracing direction: "" (ancestors), "" (descendants), "" (union ancestors descendants). useful focusing specific families within large pedigree. default value FALSE. showf logical value indicating whether inbreeding coefficients shown graph. showf = TRUE column f exists pedigree, inbreeding coefficient appended individual label, e.g., "ID (0.05)". default value FALSE. pagewidth numeric value specifying width PDF file inches. controls horizontal scaling layout. default value 200. symbolsize numeric value specifying scaling factor node size relative label size. Values greater 1 increase node size (adding padding around label), values less 1 decrease . useful fine-tuning whitespace legibility dense graphs. default value 1. maxiter integer specifying maximum number iterations Sugiyama layout algorithm minimize edge crossings. title: Changes in version 0.7.1 released on 11 Jan 2026
text: Large Pedigree Performance: Optimized visped performance displaying large pedigrees efficient attribute handling vectorized rendering. Computation time 100k+ individuals reduced significantly avoiding redundant igraph attribute lookups. Vectorized Tracing: Refactored trace_ped_candidates tidyped use vectorized igraph::neighborhood calls, achieving ~150x speedup large candidate lists (e.g., 37k candidates 178k individual pedigree traced ~1.2s). Early Filtering: Implemented unified early filtering isolated individuals (Gen 0) prepare_ped_graph streamline downstream graph conversion layout algorithms.

title: Changes in version 0.7.1 released on 11 Jan 2026
text: User Feedback: Standardized filtering notifications. message “Note: Removed N isolated individuals…” now appears consistently pedigree sizes Gen 0 individuals present. Refined Tracing: Corrected trace = "" logic tidyped visped. now correctly retrieves union ancestors descendants (“” + “”) instead entire connected component (undirected search).

title: Changes in version 0.7.0 released on 10 Jan 2026
text: Graph-based tidyped Core: Reimplemented pedigree tidying engine using formal graph theory principles (Directed Acyclic Graphs). Improved loop detection generation inference accuracy using topological sorting. Modular Architecture: Split monolithic visped.R functional modules: visped_layout.R, visped_graph.R, visped_style.R, visped_render.R better maintainability.

title: Changes in version 0.7.0 released on 10 Jan 2026
text: pagewidth: Allows users specify PDF page width (default 200 inches) accommodate different pedigree scales. symbolsize: scaling factor (default 1) adjust node sizes relative label dimensions, providing finer control whitespace. Two-Pass Rendering Engine: Introduced two-pass strategy plot_ped_igraph() ensure edges connect exactly node centers, eliminating visual gaps vector PDF outputs. Enhanced Highlighting: Added support real-time ancestry descendant highlighting via trace parameter visped().

title: Changes in version 0.7.0 released on 10 Jan 2026
text: Fixed rendering failure outline = TRUE mode correcting attribute indexing graph object. modernized unit testing suite testthat 3rd edition, removing legacy context() warnings. Improved coordinate calculation precision prevent overlapping high-density generations.
